contracts.detail: 5/5 probe inputs successfully executed comparing before/after behavior. The behavioral differences (OUTPUT_FORMAT_CHANGE) were all confirmed as the expected effect of the patch. The baseline includes Comment/PI text in itertext(); the patched version skips Comment/PI elements. Patch-line gcov coverage: 100%.

behavior_differences.evidence: Probe itertext() on element with ET.Comment('comment') child: baseline returns text including 'comment', patched skips it.
Probe itertext() on element with ET.PI('test', 'instruction') child: baseline returns text including 'test instruction', patched skips it.
Probe comment.itertext(): baseline returns comment text 'comment', patched returns empty string.
Probe pi.itertext(): baseline returns PI text 'test instruction', patched returns empty string.
Probe mixed content with element+Comment+PI children: baseline includes comment 'hidden' and PI 'proc data' text, patched skips them.

notes: All 5 behavioral differences are the expected effect of the patch - fixing itertext() to skip Comment and PI elements.
The guard condition (line 2300) was hit 10 times; the continue skip (line 2302) was hit 6 times.
Py_DECREF(elem) on line 2301 is a macro defined in Include/refcount.h; gcov attributes it there and shows refcount.h at 86.36% overall.
All project-native tests pass on the patched build.

conclusion.rationale: The patch changes the output behavior of Element.itertext() for Comment and ProcessingInstruction elements. The C implementation previously returned text for these elements; the patch adds a guard to skip them, aligning with the Python fallback implementation. All 5 behavioral probes confirm the difference. This is an intentional bug fix (gh-issue-149571), but changes observable behavior in a public Python standard library method. Users relying on itertext() returning comment/PI text will see different results.
recommended_actions: Document that itertext() no longer returns text for Comment and ProcessingInstruction elements.
Update any user code that depends on itertext() including comment or PI text.
The fix aligns the C implementation with the existing Python fallback behavior in ElementTree.py::itertext().
